Introduction
Compared to the previous generation, Hydro PTM PRO is an IEC62368 certified PSU that has been greatly
improved in its safety design as well as a more compact dimension without compromising its efficiency. And has
exclusive Off-Wet technology, the conformal coating which protects the power supply and its internal components
from dust, humidity, stains and harsh environments, the Hydro PTM PRO series are tested to work perfectly even
in 95% relative humidity.
